items.title: Put v0.8 on GitHub, and reconcile the branches

slices.statement: The remote is re-audited, the evidence pre-push gate runs, and develop is pushed
A develop-to-main pull request is merged with a merge commit after explicit authorization
The merge result is brought back into develop so main is an ancestor with no content difference

items.title: Promote the Ubuntu installer through clean native environments

slices.statement: Fresh install, source-layout migration and upgrade across prereleases are rehearsed in a clean environment
Downgrade refusal and rollback, remove and reinstall, and profile discovery are rehearsed
Operation with neither source nor a development toolchain present is rehearsed

items.title: Harden the destructive lifecycle, and decide the profile race

slices.statement: Backup capacity and corruption faults and restore drills are executed against disposable profiles
Process, mount and symlink races, external profile roots and modified installed artifacts are exercised
The profile-registry validation race is fixed or refused with a reason
Uninstall is proved never to delete user data

items.title: Resolve signing, notarization and timestamping policy

slices.statement: Each supported platform has a signing, notarization and timestamping policy somebody else can follow
Secret handling keeps material out of pull-request jobs, logs, artifacts, backups and the repository
What remains blocked without an owner account or native trust service is recorded as blocked

items.title: Generate and verify the release evidence set

slices.statement: Checksums, SBOM, dependency/license/security reports and provenance are generated and verified offline
GitHub workflows are pinned by digest and least-privilege
A non-public release-candidate or draft flow is exercised without publishing

items.title: Soak, recover, and freeze the support matrix

slices.statement: Long-lived installed directory, REST and emulator soak tests run to completion with durations recorded
Support-bundle redaction, crash-reporting policy and disaster-recovery drills are executed
The desktop support matrix is frozen and names only what was executed
REST, MCP, archive, sync, configuration, installer and Make lifecycle candidates are frozen with green suites
The shared C ABI is frozen and its ownership, leak, double-free and wrong-handle failures are exercised
Concurrent-shutdown, cancellation and stream-limit behaviour is tested at the edges
Install, upgrade, rollback and backup/restore documentation is written for a reader with no repository
Uninstall, purge, troubleshooting and artifact-verification documentation is written for that reader
Every command shown is generated from or checked against the real command line

items.title: Serve the documentation site from notrios.com

slices.statement: Hugo's baseURL is the real site address and the built output carries a CNAME
The site contract records the configured base URL and the check compares the two rather than a literal
